summary: Unpacks a structured packet from buffer a1: the header WORD at a1[0] is a declared payload size compared against a computed byte count derived from the bitfield at a2+36 (value >> 3 plus a carry bit when the low 3 bits are non-zero); on match, qmemcpy copies the payload bytes (starting 4 bytes past a1) to the destination pointer at a2+20. Regardless of the match, MemcpyLikeWithRealloc copies the trailing data block whose size is a1[1] from after the declared payload. Always returns 1. Called by sub_57CB50 (0057CB50).

local_names.a1: input buffer; header WORD at +0x0 (declared payload size) and WORD at +0x2 (trailing copy size)
local_names.a2: packet-state/descriptor object carrying a destination pointer at +20 and a bit-packed length/flag field at +36
local_names.v2: payload pointer, 4 bytes past the header (a1 + 2 words)

operations.description: Set v2 to the payload start, a1 advanced by 2 words (4 bytes) past the header WORDs

Compare the declared payload size in the header WORD at a1[0] against the computed byte count from the bitfield at a2+36 (value >> 3 plus 1 when the low 3 bits are non-zero); the payload qmemcpy runs only on equality
When the size guard passes, qmemcpy the computed byte count from the payload pointer v2 to the destination pointer stored at a2+20
Call MemcpyLikeWithRealloc to copy the trailing data block starting after the declared payload, sized by the header WORD at a1[1]
